description: Pull your BuildAlert dashboard offline — every matched planning lead, transaction, and ROI metric queryable via SQL/FTS, JSON-pipeable, and ZAZU-aware.
auth_description:
BuildAlert authenticates via the same session cookies your browser uses on the dashboard.
Run `buildalert-pp-cli auth login --chrome` to capture cookies from your logged-in Chrome profile.
No API key is published; the cookie-based path is the only path.

novel_features.name: ZAZU diff
novel_features.description: List BuildAlert leads that aren't yet in your ZAZU bd-mirror.sqlite, so you know exactly what BuildAlert's 400+ council coverage adds to your own scrapers.

novel_features.name: Pending-letter worklist
novel_features.description: Surface BuildAlert leads where canSendLetter is true, no letter has been sent yet, and ZAZU's own send log has no record either — the morning worklist for outreach.

novel_features.name: Duplicate-letter guard
novel_features.description: Find BuildAlert leads where letterBeenSent is true AND ZAZU's send log already records a Telegram send for the same applicant — i.e., a double-mailed homeowner.

novel_features.name: Council coverage gap map
novel_features.description: Group leads by council across both BuildAlert and ZAZU stores; flag councils where BuildAlert has volume but ZAZU has nothing (and vice versa).

novel_features.name: Spend ledger by council
novel_features.description: Aggregate the £2-per-letter charges across the local transactions mirror, grouped by council, project type, or month — the answers your accountant asks for.

novel_features.name: Per-lead ROI joiner
novel_features.description: Join transactions × tracking × applications locally to produce per-lead rows: cost, reply received, work won, total return — sorted by ROI.

novel_features.name: Offline radius re-filter
novel_features.description: Compute haversine distance from any UK postcode against the local mirror's lat/lng coordinates; return all leads inside a radius without re-hitting the API.
